alternative_fix_sites: quarry/parser.py::Parser.expression (any loop that folds equal-precedence operators to the left)
notes: Binary operators of equal precedence group to the right, so 10 - 4 - 3 is 9 and 12 / 2 * 3 is 2. Associative chains (a + b + c, AND, OR, ||) and mixed precedence (2 + 3 * 4) are unaffected (public tests pass). Symptoms appear in values, WHERE filters, UPDATE results and generated column names; patching evaluation or the canonical text cannot fix all three.
